scheme_name: Long Term Fellowship under the Human Resource Development Programme for Health Research
other_conditions: Applicants must be working in Indian institutes
Must possess an MD/MS/MDS or MBBS/BDS/MVSc/M.Sc./M.Pharma/M.Tech or equivalent with a Ph.D. in a health/medical research related topic
Must have at least three years of experience as a regular employee in the institute
Must be below 45 years of age as of the last date of receipt of application
Must not have availed any fellowship of one month or longer from any Government of India or State Government agency for the same subject of training/research project
Fellowship duration is 6‑12 months and is non‑transferable
benefits_summary: Provides a consolidated stipend of ₹40,000 per month (₹20,000 if training at the same station) for Indian institutes or US$3,000 per month for foreign institutes, along with contingency grants and travel allowances for a 6‑12 month fellowship.
